title: Summer opens 15 May
concept: A single arched window, like a whitewashed Alentejo doorway, opens onto the estuary where a terracotta-sailed boat catches the last light; the date is set as monumental serif numerals beside it, like a page in a slow-living magazine. The perk (the sunset boat trip) is the picture itself, so the offer is seen before it is read.
style: Kinfolk / slow living x editorial serif (ivory paper, arch photo window, tracked caps)
attention_mechanics: giant bold number '15' as first read (C1)
